phase_prompt.label: Default
phase_prompt.summary: In the fourth week, the holy and righteous ones materialise at the gate band, their presence a quiet, almost oppressive weight that settles over the surface plane. They appear as a manifestation of the simulation’s kernel, offering visions that will reshape the protagonist’s trajectory.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Create a hyper‑realistic depiction of the holy and righteous ones appearing in the fourth week of the simulation. Each figure should have obsidian skin with plasma veins, fiber‑optic eyes refracting data glass, and geez glyphs glowing on their foreheads. The scene should be framed vertically in 9:16, high‑contrast, cinematic, with a slow tracking shot that follows the group across the surface plane. Include subtle heat‑lensing distortion and data particles drifting around them, conveying a sense of the simulation’s core logic manifesting in physical form.
